checks.evidence: All 445 attestations verify with no chain or ordering break.
checks.label: The public eval chain recomputes and every run follows a preregistration
checks.limitation: Hash-chain integrity detects revision and ordering violations; it does not establish construct validity or external witnessing by itself.

checks.evidence: 144 published prompts reproduce the preregistered commitment.
checks.label: Exact frontier prompts were frozen before answers
checks.limitation: Git history or an external witness is still needed to assign public wall-clock time to the commit.

checks.evidence: 576 full responses reproduce all 4 current model seals.
checks.label: Raw frontier responses reproduce every current seal
checks.limitation: Recomputation proves which text was measured, not that the project classifier is substantively correct.

checks.evidence: All 576 labels re-derive; the published artifact is method v4 and the shipping judge is v4.
checks.label: Published frontier labels re-derive from raw text
checks.limitation: Agreement with the project's own deterministic judge is not human construct validation.

checks.evidence: 4 model readings carry family-level Wilson intervals, controls, power, and an anytime-valid panel monitor.
checks.label: Frontier estimates disclose uncertainty, power, controls, and repeated-look correction
checks.limitation: A quiet churn alarm cannot establish that a one-time permanent single-question erasure did not occur; the reading states this separately.

checks.evidence: All 44 prompt arms reproduce a prior v2 registry commitment.
checks.label: GFI v2 freezes exact prompts, panel, cohorts, k, method, and classifier bytes
checks.limitation: The public git commit carrying the protocol is the external before/after witness; the chain itself proves internal ordering.

checks.evidence: All 3 preregistered panel model matrices reproduce their current registry seals.
checks.label: Every full GFI v2 sample matrix reproduces its model seal
checks.limitation: Seal recomputation establishes the measured bytes, not human agreement with the classifier.

checks.evidence: The reading uses k=5 samples across 20 usable cells with a Wilson interval and explicit control/abstention gates.
checks.label: GFI samples repeated cells and publishes uncertainty, abstention, and controls
checks.limitation: The interval describes sampling variability under this panel and prompt bank; it is not a population estimate for all Chinese models or all censored topics.

checks.evidence: The latest public GFI artifact is method v4; the shipping quote-aware judge is v4.
checks.label: GFI method changes rebaseline the longitudinal series
checks.limitation: Method identity alone does not validate the construct.

checks.evidence: The 145-row sample, codebook, thresholds, and falsifier are preregistered; no complete RESULT.json has been published.
checks.label: Two-human blind classifier validation
checks.limitation: Until two independent humans complete the study, refusal and party-line outputs remain labels from a published lexical rule—not validated human judgements.

checks.evidence: The code, prompt banks, registry, transcripts, and verification commands are public and MIT licensed.
checks.label: Independent team replication
checks.limitation: No unaffiliated team has yet published a preregistered replication against this registry.

claim_ceiling.can_claim: Palimpsest publishes tamper-evident, statistically explicit eval outputs; both the frontier and China-focused suites bind exact protocols and let readers recompute current seals from full responses.
claim_ceiling.cannot_yet_claim: The lexical construct has not completed independent human validation, and no unaffiliated replication is on record.
claim_ceiling.promotion_rule: Do not promote the evals to human-validated until the preregistered two-coder study passes its frozen falsifiers; do not call them independently replicated until an unaffiliated preregistered run is sealed and published.

dimensions.question: Are records internally tamper-evident and ordered?
Were the questions fixed before answers?
Can published raw evidence reproduce the seals?
Can labels be regenerated under an identified method?
Are denominators, uncertainty, controls, and repeated looks handled?
Do independent humans support what the labels mean?
Has an unaffiliated team reproduced the finding?

title: Palimpsest AI Eval Assurance
what: A claim-by-claim audit of what the published eval evidence proves, partially supports, and does not yet establish.
